headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Fed's Goolsbee supports decision to hold rates steady in July
headlines.summary_en: Fed's Goolsbee says he supports the July decision to hold rates steady. He notes that recent productivity data in two periods has been weak, and if productivity continues to decline, the Fed may need to reassess market expectations on artificial intelligence (AI). Goolsbee says the latest CPI data is encouraging, but more data is needed before making a judgment; persistent consumer weakness is concerning, though soft retail sales are only a one-month performance so far. Meanwhile, US GDP and the labor market remain broadly stable.

headlines.title: 沃伦致函 要求贝森特说明干预日元的依据
headlines.summary: 美国参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦要求财政部长斯科特·贝森特解释特朗普政府干预日元的依据，延续了这位资深民主党人对特朗普政府外汇政策进行审查的一贯做法。沃伦在一封日期为8月13日的信中写道，“迄今为止，政府仍未就此次干预提供详细依据，也没有正式披露动用了多少与纳税人相关的资金来购买日元。”在7月31日采取相关行动后，贝森特证实了媒体有关美日自1998年以来首次联合干预汇市以支撑日元的报道，但尚未说明动用了多少资金。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: Warren sends letter demanding Bessent explain basis for yen intervention
headlines.summary_en: US Senator Elizabeth Warren is demanding Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent explain the Trump administration's basis for intervening in the yen, continuing the senior Democrat's pattern of scrutinizing the Trump administration's foreign exchange policy. In an August 13-dated letter, Warren wrote, 'The administration has yet to provide a detailed rationale for the intervention, nor has it formally disclosed how much taxpayer-related funds were used to buy yen.' After the July 31 action, Bessent confirmed media reports of the first US-Japan joint currency intervention since 1998 to support the yen, but has not yet specified the amount used. (Bloomberg)

headlines.summary: 今天（8月14日），上海市委书记陈吉宁用一整天时间在中国（上海）自由贸易试验区临港新片区调研并主持召开座谈会。陈吉宁指出，临港新片区要始终把先进制造业摆在突出位置，坚定不移提升能级和核心竞争力。抢抓数智化绿色化机遇，在抓好项目落地同时更加注重培育产业生态，注重培育龙头企业和高成长企业，注重布局产业平台、提升服务能力，增强产业发展的韧性和黏性，推动集成电路、民用航空、智能汽车、高端装备等主导产业积厚成势。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: push forward leading industries including integrated circuits, civil aviation, smart vehicles, and high-end equipment
headlines.summary_en: Today (August 14), Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining spent the full day researching and chairing a symposium at the China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone Lin-gang Special Area. Chen noted that Lin-gang should keep advanced manufacturing at the forefront and unwaveringly enhance its capabilities and core competitiveness. Seizing the digital-intelligent and green opportunities, it should focus on project implementation while also cultivating the industrial ecosystem, nurturing leading and high-growth enterprises, and laying out industrial platforms to improve service capacity, boosting the resilience and stickiness of industrial development, and driving integrated circuits, civil aviation, intelligent vehicles, high-end equipment and other leading industries to build momentum.

headlines.title: 中创新航预计上半年净利润至少翻倍：得益于新客户、新应用场景拓展
headlines.summary: 中创新航发布2026年中期业绩预告。公告显示，上半年公司预计实现净利润约人民币15.06亿元至15.81亿元，较去年同期（同比）上升约100%至110%。去年同期，中创新航净利润约为人民币7.53亿元。公告称，公司利润同比上升，主要得益于新客户、新应用场景拓展，以及新产品在乘用、商用、储能等领域持续上量，业务规模持续增长。

headlines.title_en: CALB expects at least doubled net profit in H1, driven by new customers and application scenarios
headlines.summary_en: Gotion High-tech releases its 2026 interim earnings forecast. The announcement shows that the company expects net profit of approximately 1.506 billion to 1.581 billion yuan in H1, up about 100% to 110% year-on-year. In the same period last year, Gotion's net profit was about 753 million yuan. The announcement says the year-on-year profit increase is mainly driven by expansion into new customers and application scenarios, as well as continued volume growth of new products in passenger, commercial and energy storage segments, with business scale continuing to rise.
